meta.heading: Canone all'Unisono
meta.note: The canon is the usual way round — subject first, answer a bar later, 126 of 161 notes echoed. What is unusual is that the answering voice is already sounding before the subject arrives: it opens bar 1 with free material and only starts echoing once the leader has entered in bar 2. The part that will follow is heard first; the canon itself is not reversed. (Wording corrected 2026-07-22 after the literature review — the earlier note claimed 'the leader enters first is false', which contradicts every published description and overstates what the data shows.)
